category: currency exchange rate API (alias domain of AllRatesToday)

free_tier.stated: The pricing page of exchange-rateapi.com redirects to the AllRatesToday pricing page, so the Free plan is the AllRatesToday Free plan: 1 API key, 10 requests a minute, and a lifetime request total whose size is not published.
free_tier.notes: The home page and the sign-up page of exchange-rateapi.com carry AllRatesToday content and AllRatesToday links. The terms page on exchange-rateapi.com names its own service, Exchange Rate API. See data-apis/allratestoday for the plan numbers.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the request total bounds what a free key can pull

interface_detail: the same REST API as AllRatesToday, at allratestoday.com/api/v1/rates with a Bearer key
tooling: any HTTP client; the same SDKs as AllRatesToday
chaining: Use the AllRatesToday record data-apis/allratestoday for limits and data-apis/allratestoday-open for the keyless lane; this domain adds no separate quota.

limits.value: the AllRatesToday lifetime total of Free requests; its size is not published
10 requests a minute on the Free plan (AllRatesToday pricing page)

binding_note: The lifetime total never resets, so it ends the key before the per-minute rate matters.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page is the AllRatesToday page: email and password, or Google or GitHub; no card.

reliability_note: The terms on this domain say a call past the plan rate limit answers HTTP 429 and that persistent overuse may lead to suspension.
confidence_note: The pricing and sign-up pages read here are identical to the AllRatesToday pages, and a fetch of the pricing URL showed a redirect to allratestoday.com. No key was created.

evidence.proved: the pricing URL of exchange-rateapi.com ends on the AllRatesToday pricing page
the home page of exchange-rateapi.com is the AllRatesToday home page
evidence.quote: # AllRatesToday Real-Time Exchange Rate API for Developers

evidence.proved: latest central-bank tables are on the free plan
evidence.quote: The latest published rates are available on every plan, including Free.

evidence.proved: the sign-up page read from exchange-rateapi.com offers Google and GitHub
the terms of exchange-rateapi.com ask users to cache responses
evidence.quote: 3. Cache API responses where appropriate to minimize unnecessary requests.

evidence.proved: past the plan limit the API answers HTTP 429
evidence.quote: If you exceed your plan's rate limit, the API will return an HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) response.

notes: Free requests: the AllRatesToday lifetime total, size not published. Rate limit: 10 requests a minute. Bulk path: none on the free key; see data-apis/allratestoday-open. This record and data-apis/allratestoday describe one offer.

extras.bulk_path: none on the free key; the keyless AllRatesToday GitHub dataset is the bulk route
